name: idea-reality-check
description: Stress-test product ideas against real-world evidence before building.

interface.longDescription: Investigate whether a product idea addresses a real user problem before building. Separate the problem from the proposed solution; research existing products and prior art; test hidden assumptions against user behavior and real-world constraints; examine why similar solutions have not become mainstream; compare simpler alternatives; and recommend the cheapest next experiment. Findings depend on accessible sources and are not legal, patent freedom-to-operate, or investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Stress-test my product idea before I build it.
Separate the problem I observed from the solution I proposed.
Find the cheapest experiment to test my riskiest assumption.

publication.release_notes: Package v0.1.1 adds portable Agent Plugins packaging and submission metadata around the existing v0.1 Skill. The shared SKILL.md and analysis workflow are unchanged. No MCP server or backend is included.

zh-CN.subtitle: 用证据压力测试产品创意
zh-CN.description: 在投入开发前，用真实需求、现有方案、专利与 prior art、用户行为和现实约束检验产品创意。区分问题与解决方案，审视隐藏假设和更简单的替代方案，并推荐最低成本实验。结论受可访问资料影响，不构成法律、专利自由实施或投资意见。
